title: Ministry of Education and collaborators 2022 Natural ventilation case study
supports: A 10 by 7.5 metre Open Air classroom; this building type was mainly constructed 1930–1965. Single classroom study, not a stock survey. Supports archetype dimensions and building form, not the assumed ventilation rate or prevalence of poor ventilation.

title: Ministry of Education Ventilation for school buildings
supports: Above 800 ppm for over an hour suggests more ventilation; sustained above 2000 ppm warrants property adviser contact. Maintain window and door operation. IEM devices can be requested at no cost to schools.

title: NZ Treasury Discount Rates
supports: Real pre-tax 2 percent central and mandatory 8 percent sensitivity. Rates alone do not make this budgeting illustration a societal cost-benefit analysis.
